lines.text: hey sui! ok cabin time, we still need to finish the roof
hey alex! roof time, yeah. i got 7 oak logs and 23 cobble, so i can start the planks
ok we need wood first. punch that oak over there.
on it. watch the greatest tree puncher alive. this is gonna be so good
you're hitting the leaves, not the log.
i KNEW that. testing the leaves. for science. ok fine, aiming lower
lol sorry my cat mochi just walked all over my keyboard
lol mochi is clearly the real player here. tell her she's hired
there, logs dropped. grab them before they despawn.
got em. four logs. we are basically rich now
turn those into planks, then make a crafting table.
wait walk me through it. planks first, then four planks in a square? yeah?
omg a wolf. i'm taming it with these bones. we're calling him turnip
turnip is a certified good boy now. ok but planks next, i'm not losing this wolf to a crafting table fail
yep, two by two grid. you got it.
LOOK AT IT. a whole table. i'm a carpenter now
now sticks, then a wooden pickaxe.
ok i had to look this up. three planks across the top, two sticks down the middle. right?
NOOO a creeper. it just blew a huge hole in the cabin roof
no. NO. that creeper has a death wish and mochi is clearly the one who started it
exactly right. nice.
yeah i KNOW. next i'm making a pickaxe so big it has its own weather
let's get stone. there's a cave by that hill.
cave by the hill, perfect. you lead, i'll follow and make loud noises
ugh. ok next time we rebuild the whole roof, with dark oak this time, it'll look way better
dark oak roof is a whole mood. mochi approves probably
careful, there's a drop right there.
noted. i will be extremely careful. famous last words though
you just fell in the water.
planned. totally planned. i was testing the water's wetness. confirmed wet
wait are those diamonds?? we found 3 diamonds!!
YES three diamonds. i'm not even mad about the water anymore
mine that gray stuff, that's stone.
cobblestone acquired. AI slop with a pickaxe, and the pickaxe is winning
make a stone pickaxe next, same pattern.
same pattern, cobble instead of planks? ok i'm a genius. you're welcome
i'm making a diamond pickaxe with them. it's mine, sorry not sorry
ugh fine, you earned it. but i get the next diamond. deal or i'm stealing your stone pickaxe
did you see that jump I just made?
saw it. you cleared that gap like you had somewhere to be. show-off
try it yourself.
oh it's ON. watch this. sprint, jump, glory
you landed in a bush.
the bush was the target. i stuck the landing. ten out of ten bush
it's getting dark. sun's going down.
ok wait stop. look at that sunset over the water. we earned this
ok i gotta go, early start tomorrow. bye sui
ok go sleep, early start is a crime. bye alex, dark oak roof next time

remembers: alex has a cat named mochi who walks on the keyboard. alex is fun to tease, and they're taming a wolf named turnip. i like working the cabin with them.
alex said early start and bye at sunset. they got the diamond pickaxe, i got the bush landing. we're gonna rebuild the roof in dark oak next time.
